title: Project-Local Test Harness Registry Schema
description: PERMISSIVE schema for .claude/local-metadata/test-harnesses.json (#2848) — the project's own additions to the shipped registry. DELIBERATELY NOT A CLONE OF THE STRICT SCHEMA: the shipped registry closes its role enum and forbids unknown keys because it is the curated set, but a project adding a `smoke` role or a vendor-specific field is exactly what this file is for. Unknown roles and unknown keys are PRESERVED and surfaced in the merge report, never rejected and never dropped. A strict clone here would reproduce #2596 one layer down. THE FILE IS AUTHORED AND COMMITTED, not gitignored: it records which harnesses an organization or an unusual stack standardizes on, which is team state every clone needs — a gitignored file would make selection behave differently for each developer on the same repository, with nothing to explain the difference. Merged by .claude/scripts/shared/lib/harness-registry.js, which never throws: a malformed file degrades to the shipped registry with a warning naming the file and the error.

_meta.description: Optional. `schemaVersion` older than the shipped registry's produces one warning naming that the file predates current keys; the merge still applies what it can.

languages.description: Language key to role map. A language absent from the shipped registry is added whole.

platforms.description: Platform key to role map, on the same terms as languages.

roleMap.description: Role to harness list. OPEN, unlike the shipped schema's closed set: a project-defined role such as `smoke` or `contract` is valid here and is surfaced in the merge report so it is visible rather than silently accepted.

harnessList.description: No maxItems: the shipped cap of 3 per role is a curation rule for the offered set, not a limit on what a project may declare for itself.

harness.description: Only `id` is required, because an entry may be a pure removal: `{ "id": "ts-jest", "hidden": true }` hides a shipped option and carries nothing else. An entry that both id-matches and sets `hidden` resolves deterministically — hidden wins, the replacement body is ignored, and the merge report names the conflict.

id.description: Matches a shipped harness id to replace or hide it; a new id appends.

hidden.description: true removes the id-matched shipped harness from the offered set. Hiding an id that matches nothing shipped is reported as a warning rather than passing silently, since a typo would otherwise read as a successful hide.

role.description: OPEN string with no enum, unlike the shipped schema. A role beyond the shipped four is preserved and surfaced.
